phenotype_specificity.statement: Only cohort-level phenotype data; the cohort was enrolled after genetic confirmation of SSADHD. No statement about testing of other genes.

quotes.quote: Movement disorders were present in 32 (55%) subjects: 30 (52%) had ataxia, 14 (24%) had dyskinesia, and 9 (15%) had dystonia.
After being genetically confirmed with SSADHD, subjects enrolled in the natural history study undergo a series of clinical and laboratory assessments biennially.

variant_type_and_mechanism.statement: Single-nucleotide deletion at intron position +3 after c.870 (no protein consequence stated). The paper describes the disease as autosomal recessive.

quotes.quote: Succinic semialdehyde dehydrogenase deficiency (SSADHD) (OMIM #271980) is a rare (prevalent in ~ 1/460,000^1) inherited metabolic disorder caused by autosomal recessive inheritance of ALDH5A1 sequence variants^2.

computational_predictions.statement: SpliceAI delta score 0.75 (loss) in Table 1; the text groups it with splice variants having high delta scores and a predicted complete lack of protein. The genotype is modelled as "Truncated protein/impaired splicing", effect "No protein".

quotes.quote: Splice-site variant analysis with SpliceAI revealed that 5 out 6 of the splice-site variants (c.1015–2A > C, c.870 + 3delA, c.1402 + 2T > C, c.870 + 1G > T, c.610–2A > G) had high Δ scores (mean ± SD of 0.88 ± 0.12), indicating a high probability for aberrant splicing, alteration in the frame of the translated protein’s frame, and a predicted complete lack of SSADH protein.

Splice-site variant analysis with SpliceAI revealed that 5 out 6 of the splice-site variants (c.1015-2A > C, c.870 + 3delA, c.1402 + 2T > C, c.870 + 1G > T, c.610-2A > G) had high Δ scores (mean ± SD of 0.88 ± 0.12), indicating a high probability for aberrant splicing, alteration in the frame of the translated protein's frame, and a predicted complete lack of SSADH protein.
Analysis of splice-site variants was performed using SpliceAI^13, an interface for splicing prediction ideal for intronic variants that are +/− 50 bp from exon borders.

authors_classification.statement: Only the blanket statement covering all 32 cohort variants; c.870 + 3delA is not in the list of previously unreported variants.

quotes.quote: This study’s findings determined that the 32 allelic variants (eight of which are novel), present in 41 unique allelic combinations (Table 1) in 58 SSADHD participants, were pathogenic.

concerns: PMIDs 37503297 and 37962671 carry the same Research Square preprint text (DOI 10.21203/rs.3.rs-3111263/v1); 37962671 states a version was later published in Human Genetics. The two rows are one person counted once (same identity), not independent observations.

The person appears only as a numbered row in a genotype table of a natural-history cohort; there is no individual case description, sex, age or phenotype for this row. The cohort is 58 individuals from 50 families, so some rows are relatives, but the paper does not say which.
Zygosity is given only as a table label; the paper does not report parental testing or how phase was established.
Intron numbering in Table 1 is internally inconsistent: c.870 + 3delA is placed in intron 5 and c.870 + 1G > T, two bases away, in intron 6.
c.870 + 3delA is not among the eight variants the authors call previously unreported, but the paper gives no citation for an earlier report.
No transcript is stated in this paper.
notes_for_panel: A different variant at the same splice donor, c.870 + 1G > T, occurs homozygous in #32 and #33 of the same cohort; it is not this candidate.
